title: A bug the user reported always needs a red proof
description: A case marked "reported" reproduces a symptom the user described, in their words. It must be seen failing before the fix in every tier, because a fix for a reported bug with no reproduction is a guess that the user is then asked to trust.

clauses.text: A reported case with no red proof fails the run even when --require-red-proof was not passed.
clauses.observable_by: runMatrix without requireRedProof returns a FAIL red-proof leg whose breaker names the reported case

clauses.text: Cases that are not reported stay advisory when --require-red-proof was not passed.
clauses.observable_by: runMatrix without requireRedProof returns a PASS red-proof leg for an unproven ordinary case

clauses.text: A reported case must carry the user's words and cannot be a guard.
clauses.observable_by: validateContract rejects an empty "reported" and a reported case marked "guard"

cases.description: quick run, reported case, no proof recorded
quick run, ordinary case, no proof recorded
